title: Headless There Stands the Grass (VMS06), Keely's spore purge: the purge gas lit by a laser completes objective 50 (#2687)

actions.text: Path: Hildern sends the player to Vault 22 (10); Keely's line INFO 0x000F43F8 completes objective 40, shows 50 and enables the purge gas V22SporePurgeGasRef (0x000F0908); a laser shot reaches the gas (its OnHitWith ExplodesGasTrapsOnHit runs DamageObject 5), stage 1 destroys it and its OnDestructionStageChange completes objective 50 and shows 60. Stand-ins: the quest started by its stage; Keely's earlier lines by objectives 30 and 40; the shot by hit (the engine's shot through the gas: engine/nvf-play/src/gas_traps.rs).
